revenueModel.text: The company earns staking rewards by delegating its SOL to third-party validators and earns revenue from selling branded consumer products.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company earns staking revenue by delegating its digital assets to third-party validators on proof-of-stake blockchain networks.

changes.text: In 2026, the Company sold E-Core, Technology Inc. and its subsidiaries, leaving a single segment of branded product sales and distribution.
changes.evidence: The Company's financial reporting is organized into a single segment that includes sales and distribution of branded products, following the sale of E-Core, Technology Inc. and its subsidiaries.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company shifted its treasury strategy to hold digital currency assets, primarily Solana, directly on its balance sheet.
changes.evidence: Early in 2025, we updated and modified our cash management and treasury strategy to include holding digital currency assets directly on our balance sheet.

changes.text: In 2026, the Company exited certain manufacturing and distribution operations, shutting down manufacturing and distribution centers.
changes.evidence: During the year ended June 30, 2026, as a result of the Company's course of action to shut down these manufacturing and distribution centers, a loss on disposal of $ 1,422,289 was recognized within Impairment on assets from manufacturing shut down within the Consolidated Statements of Operations.
